report:
[ORACLE] Signaling Not Working with Debezium Source Connector

Hello,
I am using the Debezium Oracle Connector version 3.0.6.
Even though I add entries for log output or incremental snapshots to the source signal channel, they are not triggered.
1.Adding signaling records (2 entries)
INSERT INTO  "C##DBZUSER".oracle_signal
(id,type,data)
values
('adhoc-1','execute-snapshot','{"data-collections": ["poccore_stg02.poc.dbz_test1"],"type":"incremental"}');
INSERT INTO  "C##DBZUSER".oracle_signal
(id,type,data)
values
('log-1','log','{"message": "Signal test-message"}');
2.Verifying the signaling records are linked to the topic
  Please refer to the attached file, topic.txt.
From the logs, neither the message output nor the incremental snapshot seems to work.
I do not see any errors, but it feels like the signaling table is not being monitored.
Is there anything I should try?
Thank you in advance.
connector.txt

topic.txt

log.zip

evidence.quote: the \"signal.data.collection\" should be given in all uppercase as that's how the object is known to Oracle"; reporter: "By setting SIGNAL.DATA.COLLECTION in uppercase ... it worked

notes: Signals were captured but silently not processed because signal.data.collection did not match the uppercase Oracle table id; the signal-table matching code (case-sensitive TableId comparison) settles it. Logs were attachments only.
